retrievalProfile.description: A vintage-style urban landscape featuring a prominent green highway overhead sign as the primary typographic vessel against a busy bridge backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle perspective of a multi-lane suspension bridge filled with vintage cars, framed by a rough deckle-edge border. A large, dark green highway directional sign is positioned in the upper right quadrant, serving as the main area for text.
coreVisualRelationships: The highway sign acts as a foreground anchor against the receding bridge perspective.
The white bridge towers provide vertical contrast to the horizontal highway lanes.
The deckle-edge border creates a physical 'printed photo' feel.
The dark green of the sign contrasts with the blue water and sky.
coreInvariants: Vintage 1970s film grain and color grading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The highway sign is large and positioned in the top right; the bridge spans from the left mid-ground into the distance.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The highway sign's support pole and green face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast text on the sign, follow the bridge's curve downward and to the left, then back up the suspension cables.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black outer margin surrounding the deckle-edged photo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and muted grey (water and road)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation tones typical of 1970s color film with high-contrast white highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant modern digital colors
Limit to earthy greens, blues, and greys

characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly softened corners to mimic reflective highway signage

composition.position: Centered on the green sign face
composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated as part of the physical sign

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all informational text on the sign.

candidateDirections.reason: Modernized version of highway signage fonts
Open-source alternative with similar geometric properties

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s color photograph of a suspension bridge with white towers and heavy traffic. Include a large blank green highway sign in the upper right. Frame the entire image with a white deckle-edge torn paper border against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a Highway Gothic font, typeset the desired text in white on the green sign face. Add a white directional arrow and a small shield icon to the left of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within the green sign?
Does the photo have a visible film grain and 70s color cast?
Is the font a clean, bold sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Exact wording from the original image

mustAchieve: Consistent perspective between sign and bridge
avoid: Modern font choices like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Verify the sign looks physically mounted in the scene.
Check that the deckle edge doesn't look like a simple white rectangle.
Ensure the cars look like 1960s-70s models.
Confirm the text is legible and properly spaced on the sign.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Urban Bridge + Highway Sign Overlay + Deckle Edge Frame
